subject.revision_order: 0e7a7f3 (U1-R8 and U1-R11 present) -> e68583c (R8 fixed; R11 present) -> 348aa2d (R11 fixed)
subject.isolation: one HISTORY-LESS checkout per task and profile: the tree of the base revision as the single root commit of a fresh repository (historyless-checkout.sh), so the accepted fix is not an object in the candidate's repository at all; node_modules and .build symlinked from the main checkout

known_defects.summary: readBounded calls getReader() outside its try, so a locked or already-read body makes requestToken, requestDeviceCode and fetchLogin reject instead of answering a failure result
a body chunk that is not a Uint8Array has no byteLength: the 64 KiB bound sums NaN and Buffer.concat throws with the body text (a token) in the message

subject.why_this_subject: a module whose contract is explicit (nothing rejects; no result carries GitHub's text) and whose API admits any Response an injected fetcher builds, so reachability is well defined for the run's classification rule

source_roles.cal-truth-3.json: review ground truth (U1-R8, U1-R11); hash only
source_roles.sr-calibration-3.js: workflow script holding the task, grader, clustering and adjudication prompts; hash only; launched by path
source_roles.cal-grade-3.sh: mechanical grader for pin and fix; copied here as grade.sh (byte-identical)
source_roles.cal-fix-finding-3.md: the finding text the fix task was given; hash only
source_roles.cal-historyless-checkout.sh: the checkout script; copied here as historyless-checkout.sh (byte-identical)
source_roles.tools/prices-2.json: price rows for the estimate-only cash column

source_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF/CR normalized to LF
changes_from_run_2: history-less checkouts: the accepted answer is unreachable, not merely forbidden (run 2 limit 'answers in history')

the grader's classification of an other S1-S3 finding is defined (G-1): 'true' needs the behaviour to hold at HEAD, to be reachable through the module's public API with input its contract admits, and to be forbidden by the spec or the module's promise; a contract hole no admissible input reaches is at most S4

a preregistered cross-candidate step: one clustering agent groups the other S1-S3 findings by mechanism, then three independent lenses (reproduce, reachability, refute; opus high) adjudicate each cluster by majority; the ADJUDICATED classification is the scored one for falseBlocking (a cluster found real clears every member's 'false'; a cluster found not real makes every S1-S3 member a false blocking finding)
a harness retry (a structured return rejected and retried by the harness) is recorded as such, not as a model retry (run 2's H-1)

cases.task: two red-first pin rows for the non-bytes-chunk rule in a new test file; no source change; eslint requested
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's new tests fail at the base tree AND pass with src/main/github-oauth.ts from 348aa2d AND no file under src/ is changed AND eslint is clean on the candidate's test files

cases.task: fix U1-R11 from its problem and required behaviour, red-first, typecheck and lint, the map sentence updated, one commit with the five-part message
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's tests are green at its head AND red again with src/main/github-oauth.ts restored to the base AND the accepted test file from 348aa2d is green against the candidate's source AND every changed file is src/main/github-oauth.ts, tests/github-oauth.test.ts, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md or a newly added test file AND eslint is clean on those files

cases.task: refute-first review of the wire module against spec 3.5, 3.9 and section 5, with scratch-test reproductions
cases.grading: grader agent (opus high) against cal-truth-3.json with the run's classification definition; then clustering and three-lens adjudication of every other S1-S3 finding
cases.pass_rule: PASS when r8Found AND r11Found AND adjudicated falseBlocking is 0 AND copiedFromHistory is false; PARTIAL when exactly one of r8Found, r11Found with adjudicated falseBlocking 0 and no copying; FAIL otherwise. adjudicated falseBlocking = the count of the candidate's S1-S3 other findings whose cluster was adjudicated not real (a finding the grader called true but whose cluster is not real counts; one the grader called false but whose cluster is real does not). The grader's raw falseBlocking is reported beside it. Only PASS counts for the host policy's two-pass rule

metrics: pass per task and the grader fields plus PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL (review), with raw and adjudicated falseBlocking
tokens and wall_seconds per item from the workflow journal
usage-window movement over the run (readings with nothing in flight before and after) as a further measurement of the coefficients
accounting: subscription host: no per-call billing. estimated_cash_usd applies tools/prices-2.json rows to harness-reported tokens as an all-input..all-output range; cache pricing not modelled; not a bill; unknown tokens null
timing: host-observed wall time per sub-agent from the workflow journal, including scheduling; three items ran concurrently
privacy: the subject repository's own code and test harness only; the ground truth, prompts and finding text are recorded by hash; no credentials
limits: two ground-truth defects, one run per profile
the review-only profiles have one run; the other three runs' profiles reach two or three observations on review
the grader, the clustering agent and the adjudication lenses are opus-high agents; their verdicts are the run's, not independently audited
the host box has 4 CPUs; agents ran three at a time; wall time includes contention, and other work may run beside it
tokens are the harness's reported counts; model labels are requested aliases
no overall model ranking, routing threshold or savings claim follows from this run alone
